---
title: "What fraction of recorded observations meets a condition?"
---

## Question

What fraction of recorded observations meets a condition?

## Work through it

Define the event precisely; count TRUE among non-missing observations; divide by the number of usable observations and report that denominator.

## Worked example: airquality

```{r}
#| eval: false
d <- ru_data("airquality")
event <- d$Ozone > 60
result <- ru_apply("event_probability", data=d, x=event, event=TRUE)
stopifnot(result["events"]<=result["trials"])
```

The result is an observed proportion of days with ozone measurements above the chosen threshold, excluding days whose ozone value is missing. It is not necessarily the chance for a randomly selected day elsewhere.

## Adapt to another question

```r
ru_apply("event_probability", data=your_data, x=your_data$measurement>60, event=TRUE)
```

If the question says 'given B', use conditional_probability, whose denominator is only the days satisfying B.

Check the input conditions with `ru_plan("event_probability")` before treating a calculation as an inference.
